identity.model_type: Roleplay and story generation hybrid model.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only architecture, merge method, and license; no training data, evaluation, or safety documentation for this exact checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card states it is a SLERP merge of two named open-weight models but provides no traceability of their training data or usage terms.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not document training/tuning dataset details for either base model or the merged checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight roleplay/story generation model with no reported safety evaluation or guardrails can plausibly generate harmful language.

possible_risks.description: Generative AI models might be used to intentionally create misleading or false information to deceive or influence a targeted audience.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight text generation model for roleplay/story generation with no reported misuse evaluation can be used to create misleading/false narratives.

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,540,133,904 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model is a merge of allura-org/TQ2.5-14B-Neon-v1 and allura-org/TQ2.5-14B-Sugarquill-v1, combined using the SLERP merge method.
